title: 陸自ロゴに批判殺到、使用中止　ゾウ小銃持ち、頭蓋骨デザイン…「悪趣味」「好戦的」
extracted_text: 陸上自衛隊第1師団の第1普通科連隊（東京都練馬区）がX（旧ツイッター）に公開した部隊の新たなロゴに「好戦的」「悪趣味」などと批判が相次ぎ、使用を中止したことが3日分かった。迷彩服を着たゾウが小銃を持ち、人の頭蓋骨や青い炎を配したデザインで、隊員が生成人工知能（AI）で作成していた。 陸自によると、ロゴは第1普通科連隊傘下の第4中隊のもので、4月29日にＸで公開した。隊員が対話型生成AI「チャットGPT」に「ゾウ」「かっこいい」「青い炎」「擬人化」などの単語を入力して作成し、中隊長が了承した。Ｘへの投稿は連隊長の許可を得ていた。 ゾウは第4中隊のシンボルとして、2002年からロゴに使われてきた。隊員の士気や帰属意識の向上を目的に、今回のデザインに変更したという。第1普通科連隊は今月2日、Ｘで「国民の皆さまに、より適切に部隊をご理解いただき、親しみを持っていただくといった観点も重視すべき」だとして使用中止を表明。ロゴの投稿も削除した。
translated_text: The Ground Self-Defense Force's 1st Division's 1st Infantry Regiment (Nerima-ku, Tokyo) posted a new unit logo on X (formerly Twitter), and it drew criticism calling it 'militaristic' and 'tasteless.' It was learned on the 3rd that use has been discontinued. The design featured an elephant in camouflage holding a small rifle and a human skull, with blue flames, created by a unit member using generative AI. According to the GSDF, the logo belonged to the 4th Company under the 1st Infantry Regiment, and was posted on X on April 29. A unit member created it by entering words like 'elephant,' 'cool,' 'blue flames,' and 'personified' into the conversational AI 'ChatGPT,' and the company commander approved it. The post on X had been made with the regiment commander's permission. The elephant has been used as the 4th Company's symbol in its logo since 2002. The design was changed this time to boost morale and strengthen soldiers' sense of belonging. On the 2nd, the 1st Infantry Regiment stated on X that it would discontinue use, saying, 'We should also place importance on allowing the public to better understand our unit and feel familiarity toward it.' The logo post was also deleted.
title_en: GSDF Logo Draws Heavy Criticism, Use Discontinued - Elephant Holding Rifle, Skull Design Labeled 'Tasteless' and 'Militaristic'
